TheEndPalettes.name: Ending palettes and GFX decompression
summary: Starts with palette data (15-bit BGR words): three 12-byte sets copied to $08A7/$08C7/$08E7 by the title screen code, followed by more color words.
CODE_00B888 (called once from game mode 00): decompresses Mario graphics (GFX32 at $08:BFC0) to $7E:2000, expands each 24-byte 3bpp tile
to a 32-byte 4bpp tile in place going backwards (bitplane 3 = 0, result ends at $7E:AD00), then decompresses the stream at $08:8000 to $7E:2000.
CODE_00B8DE: LZ2 decompressor. Parameters: [$8A]-[$8C] = source, [$00]-[$02] = destination. Commands: top 3 bits = type, low 5 bits = length - 1;
types 0 copy, 1 byte fill, 2 word fill, 3 incrementing fill, 4 copy earlier output (16-bit offset, high byte first); 111 = long form (10-bit length); $FF ends.

ReadByte.name: Read byte from 24-bit source pointer
summary: Returns the byte at [$8A] in A and advances the pointer, moving to $8000 of the next bank when it wraps.
Parameters: [$8A]-[$8C]: 24-bit source pointer. Returns: A = byte; X is clobbered; A and X sizes are the caller's.

s00BA28.name: Decompress GFX file to buffer
summary: Looks up the ROM address of GFX file Y and decompresses it to the GFX buffer at $7E:AD00 using the LZ2 decompressor.
Parameters: Y: GFX file number ($00-$31). Returns: Y and the data bank preserved; RTL.

GenerateTile.name: Generate Map16 tile at block position
summary: Called with JSL to turn a block into another tile (e.g. a hit block becoming a used block, or a vine/coin spot). Parameters: [$9C]: block to generate (0 = none),
[$98]/[$99] block Y, [$9A]/[$9B] block X, [$1933] layer. Finds the Map16 buffer of the screen, computes the VRAM position in $04-$07 and the reference
scroll position in $08/$0A, then dispatches through TileGenerationPtr with A = block - 1. Does nothing if the position is outside the level ($0200+).
Quirk: PHK/PER builds a fake JSL return address so ExecutePtr reads TileGenerationPtr as its table.

TileGenerationPtr.name: Pointer table: tile generation handlers
summary: Indexed by block number - 1 ($01-$1B). Handlers CODE_00C074/00C077/00C0C4/00C0C1/00C1AC/00C334/00C3D1 place the new tile and queue its drawing.

s00C063.name: Unused. Bit masks to clear one bit

TileToGeneratePg0.name: Table: Map16 tile per generated block, page 0
summary: Indexed by block number $00-$08: the Map16 tile ($25 empty, $06 vine, $49 tree background, $48, $2B coin, $A2, $C6 mole hole).
Followed by CODE_00C074 (flags the spot in $19F8, then falls into) CODE_00C077: places the tile for blocks $01-$08 and continues at CODE_00C0FB.

lines.00B70E: Palette 1, colors 0-3 (15-bit BGR words); first 12 bytes copied to $08A7 (palette buffer)
lines.00B71A: Palette 2, colors 0-3; 12 bytes copied to $08C7 (palette buffer)
lines.00B726: Palette 3, colors 0-3; 12 bytes copied to $08E7 (palette buffer)
lines.00B72E: Palette 3, colors 4-5, then more color words with no named reference
lines.00B87E: Last color words; then bytes C0 BF 08 = unreferenced pointer $08:BFC0 (GFX32)
lines.00B8A5: } $8D-$8F = $7E:ACFE: write pointer for the 4bpp copy, filled backwards
lines.00B8AA: X = $23FF: last byte of the $2400-byte 3bpp data (384 tiles of 24 bytes)
lines.00B8B4: } Bitplane 2 byte of a row becomes a word (bitplane 3 = 0), stored at [$8D]
lines.00B8C4: X-- (X now points at the high byte of the next word)
lines.00B8C5: A = bitplane 0/1 word of one row
lines.00B8CC: / X--; all tiles done when X < 0
lines.00B8D5: Next tile: back to the bitplane 2 loop
lines.00B8DA: / $8A = $8000: next stream is at $08:8000 (bank in $8C unchanged)
lines.00B8DC: A 8-bit; falls into the decompressor (probably GFX33, left at $7E:2000)
lines.00B8F1: } Bits 7-5 = 111: long command with a 10-bit length, go to $00B8FF
lines.00B8F8: } A = length - 1 = bits 4-0 of the command
lines.00B903: } Long command: type = bits 4-2, moved to bits 7-5
lines.00B909: } Bits 1-0 = high bits of length - 1, parked in B
lines.00B90C: Read the low byte of length - 1
lines.00B921: Type 011 (incrementing fill): read the start value
lines.00B926: Store the value in the output
lines.00B93F: Byte fill: read the fill value
lines.00B944: Store the value in the output
lines.00B94C: Word fill: read the first fill byte
lines.00B961: / Alternate the two bytes until count is 0
lines.00B96A: } X = source offset in the output (16-bit, high byte stored first)
lines.00B983: A = byte at the 24-bit source pointer [$8A]
lines.00B988: No wrap: go store the pointer
lines.00B98D: / Pointer wrapped past $FFFF: restart at $8000 of the next bank
